title: Presentation Generator input
description: Machine-readable description of one location's presentation. Field names, types and max lengths per docs/04-fields.md (WP5); page-type catalogue per docs/02-page-types.md (WP3).

project_id.description: Used to name the generated output file (<project_id>_v<NN>.pptx).

city.description: Bare city/market name, e.g. 'Basel'. Reused directly wherever the deck needs just the city (PAGE_09_SOCIAL_REACH's Instagram caption, PAGE_04_REFERENCES' computed footer) instead of a duplicate per-page field — see docs/04-fields.md 'Fields not included here'.

language.description: All 5 reference decks are German; kept as a field rather than hardcoded in case a future location needs another language.

theme_worlds.description: Ordered list of this deck's theme-world names. PAGE_01_TITLE/PAGE_02_SERVICE's optional theme-world caption is computed by the generator from theme_worlds[0] (only shown when theme_worlds has more than 2 entries) — resolved by the designer, docs/open-questions.md #12, not authored per-page. Every PAGE_03_THEME_SHOWCASE/PAGE_06_LOCAL_MOTIFS/PAGE_08_TRANSITION page occurrence still authors its own TXT_THEME_WORLD_NAME(_N) directly in its own fields (see below) — this list does not replace those, it only drives the PAGE_01/02 computed caption and lets a human/tool see the deck's theme roster at a glance.

pages.description: One entry per physical slide, in deck order. Repeating page types (PAGE_03_THEME_SHOWCASE, PAGE_06_LOCAL_MOTIFS) appear as multiple entries, one per occurrence, each with its own resolved field values — not nested/grouped.

image_path.description: Relative path to an image file, e.g. 'images/basel_title.jpg'.

fields.description: Validated per page_type below — see the matching $defs/fields_PAGE_* schema.

fields_empty.description: This page type is 100% fixed content baked into the master template — no authored fields at all.

fields_PAGE_01_TITLE.description: Presence of mandatory fields (TXT_TITLE_SUBLINE, IMG_THEME_WORLD_PHOTO per docs/04-fields.md) is intentionally not enforced by 'required' here — src/build_presentation.py checks it at generation time and writes a visible <<MISSING: ...>> marker instead of failing validation, per the task brief's WP8 step 4. This schema only enforces shape (type/length/pattern) for whichever fields are present.

fields_PAGE_02_SERVICE.description: Mandatory-field presence enforced by src/build_presentation.py at generation time (<<MISSING>> marker), not by this schema — see fields_PAGE_01_TITLE's note.

fields_PAGE_03_THEME_SHOWCASE.description: _1's mandatory presence and _2's optional presence are both enforced by src/build_presentation.py at generation time, not by this schema — see fields_PAGE_01_TITLE's note. _2 absent is the normal single-theme case (removes the unused placeholder); _1 absent gets a <<MISSING>> marker.

fields_PAGE_05_USER_FLOW.description: Mandatory-field presence enforced by src/build_presentation.py at generation time (<<MISSING>> marker), not by this schema — see fields_PAGE_01_TITLE's note.

fields_PAGE_06_LOCAL_MOTIFS.description: Headline/subheadline/stats-callout/column-headers/row-numbers are deliberately absent — they're computed by the generator from this page's position among the deck's PAGE_06_LOCAL_MOTIFS occurrences, not authored input. See docs/04-fields.md 'Fields not included here'. Mandatory-field presence (theme name, motif 1's set) and optional-field presence (motifs 2/3) are both enforced by src/build_presentation.py at generation time, not by this schema — see fields_PAGE_01_TITLE's note.

fields_PAGE_08_TRANSITION.description: TXT_THEME_WORLD_NAME_1/_2 corrects docs/04-fields.md, which only lists a bare TXT_THEME_WORLD_NAME for this page type — the actually-built templates/master_v01.pptx layout has 2 separate named placeholders, one per card. Mandatory-field presence enforced by src/build_presentation.py at generation time (<<MISSING>> marker), not by this schema — see fields_PAGE_01_TITLE's note.

fields_PAGE_09_SOCIAL_REACH.description: Mandatory-field presence enforced by src/build_presentation.py at generation time (<<MISSING>> marker), not by this schema — see fields_PAGE_01_TITLE's note.

fields_PAGE_10_CONTACT.description: Mandatory-field presence enforced by src/build_presentation.py at generation time (<<MISSING>> marker), not by this schema — see fields_PAGE_01_TITLE's note.
